tagline.login: If they get lost, the whole neighbourhood looks.
tagline.register: Create your account to look after your pets.
tagline.reset: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to reset your password.

pet.title: Add your pet
pet.description: Add your dog or cat with a photo, their breed and your contact details. If they ever get lost, the rest of the neighbourhood can help you look for them.

zone.title: Join a walking zone
zone.description: Find walking zones near you and meet other owners in your neighbourhood. You'll see who's out walking right now.

notifications.title: Turn on notifications
notifications.description: Get an alert when a pet goes missing near you, so you can lend a hand.
